cues.text: The summer festival at Naganaki Shrine: food stalls line the grounds and people stroll past in yukatas. You stand beside Fuuka, who is wearing a yukata too.
You and Fuuka make your way through the crowd to a takoyaki stall, where a woman works behind the grill.
Walking on with the takoyaki, Fuuka takes a bite of one.
At the lucky-draw stall, you reach into the box and draw a ticket while Fuuka watches.
